question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Convinient"** is incorrectly spelt; the correct spelling should be "Convenient". (सुविधाजनक)

 
 
• **Example: **It is convenient to shop online because you can do it from home.
 
 
 
• **"Embarrass"** means to cause someone to feel awkward, self-conscious, or ashamed. (शर्मिंदा करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He tried to embarrass me in front of the whole class.
 
 
 
• **"National"** refers to something that relates to a nation or country as a whole. (राष्ट्रीय)
 
 
• **Example: **The national flag was hoisted on Independence Day.
 
 
 
• **"Discipline"** means the practice of training people to obey rules or a code of behaviour, using punishment to correct disobedience. (अनुशासन)
 
 
• **Example: **Discipline is essential for maintaining order in the classroom.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Embarrass** (शर्मिंदा करना): To cause someone to feel awkward, self-conscious, or ashamed.

 
 
• **Example:** He tried to embarrass me in front of the whole class.
 
 
 
• **National** (राष्ट्रीय): Relating to a nation or country as a whole.
 
 
• **Example:** The national flag was hoisted on Independence Day.
 
 
 
• **Discipline** (अनुशासन): The practice of training people to obey rules or a code of behaviour, using punishment to correct disobedience.
 
 
• **Example:** Discipline is essential for maintaining order in the classroom.
